name: browser-app-builder
description: Guide a student from local setup to a planned, tested browser app and GitHub Pages publication, with bundled Campus Designer styling.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, evaluate, and publish a browser app. No coding experience is required.
interface.longDescription: Turn a problem you understand into a self-contained browser application, with a saved plan, local revision history, calculation evidence, and a GitHub Pages publishing workflow. Your agent handles the files and commands; you make the product and model decisions. Includes five workflow skills, a minimal starter, a Pages workflow, and the bundled Campus Designer branding skill. Build explicitly uses Campus Designer's Duke colors, typography, web, and review guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use setup-browser-app to prepare this folder.
Use plan-browser-app to help me plan a pricing scenario calculator.
Use build-browser-app to implement the agreed PLAN.md.
Use evaluate-browser-app to check the calculations with me and record the evidence.
Use deploy-browser-app to help me publish the evaluated app on GitHub Pages.

io.github.jordanmeyer.label: Pilot candidate · Instructor-built
io.github.jordanmeyer.audience: MBA students building a self-contained decision tool, dashboard, or simulation with an agent.

results.label: Maintainer fixture calculation checks passed in the browser
Git freshness and publishing boundary checks passed

io.github.jordanmeyer.method: On October 8, 2026, isolated Codex CLI 0.145.0 and Claude Code 2.1.86 installation checks found all six skills, including Campus Designer. Maintainer-authored pricing and inventory fixtures passed 25 browser calculation checks after follow-up review corrected decimal break-even arithmetic. A constant-zero-demand mutation failed the new independently calculated seeded expectation. Twelve Git/publication checks cover source freshness, plan comparisons, and packaging boundaries. These are local package and fixture checks, not student or ChatGPT Work trials.
io.github.jordanmeyer.limits: Apps run in the browser using public/synthetic datasets or locally selected files. No backends, logins, external APIs, remote AI, analytics, or secret keys. The host must provide usable file, Git, preview, and browser capabilities. This is a pilot candidate; Work, clean-machine, fresh-chat, and live-publication checks remain outstanding. Evaluation supports specific claims about tested cases; it does not certify a business model.
